verdict.rationale: SolidJS's core design is fine-grained reactive state that only reruns dependent code, plus built-in state management (Context/Stores) for composing components, corroborated by multiple hands-on accounts of building real component-based UIs (react-bootstrap port, data viz work, production apps) confirming encapsulated, composable component patterns work well. missing for 10: no explicit dedicated documentation excerpt on component composition patterns beyond signals/stores.
